gimmick: A deeply tanned, permanently flexing icon who tells children to say their prayers, eat their vitamins and buy his frying pan. He has headlined for thirty years and has never once been seen losing clean.
catchphrase: What'cha gonna do, little brother, when the bronze rubs off on YOU?
finisher_description: He cups a hand to his ear for a full minute, rips his shirt in two, and drops a slow, flat leg across the throat.

gimmick: A bald, foul-tempered roofer who hates authority, paperwork and anyone in a suit. He drinks room-temperature soda by the crate because the cooler is always broken.
catchphrase: That's the bottom of the cooler, and it's WARM!
finisher_description: A kick to the gut, a quarter turn and a jaw-jolting drop to the seat, then two cans of flat soda over the body.

gimmick: The billionaire who used to own the giant, fires people on live television, rehires them after the commercial and makes them thank him. He was pushed out of his own company and wants it back.
catchphrase: You're... FIRED. Effective after the merchandise sale.
finisher_description: He swaggers to the ring like a broken windmill while three men in suits do the beating.

gimmick: A towering funeral director for hire who has died eleven times and comes back every spring with a longer entrance.
finisher_description: He turns his victim upside down, sits them into a piledriver with their arms crossed, rolls his own eyes back, and leaves a bill.

gimmick: A film star who sits on the giant's board, raises one eyebrow, and comes back to wrestle when a sequel needs promoting.
finisher: The Super Cool Basic Elbow Drop
finisher_description: A slow, theatrical elbow drop after throwing off one elbow pad.

gimmick: A seventy-seven-year-old dirty player in a forty-thousand-dollar robe who still struts, still chops and still owes everybody money.
catchphrase: Robes. Money. Chops. In that order.
finisher_description: A figure-four leg lock, robe still on.

gimmick: A born-again showstopper who flew around rings for thirty years and now trains the next ones while preaching.
catchphrase: I've got heart. Mine broke twice.
finisher_description: A superkick preceded by stomping the mat to wind up the crowd.

gimmick: A lovable madman who fell off a cell, wrote three books about it, and keeps a sock puppet in his tights.
finisher_description: A mandible claw with a sock puppet on the hand.

gimmick: An Olympic champion with a broken neck who repeats everything three times, intensely.
finisher_description: An ankle lock held on the mat.

finishing_moves.name: Ankle Lock, Ankle Lock, Ankle Lock

gimmick: A bald powerhouse who won his first hundred and seventy-three matches and still counts out loud as he walks to the ring.
finisher_description: A spear followed by a jackhammer suplex.

gimmick: A five-time champion now on commentary, who stops mid-sentence to spin on his back.
catchphrase: Five times, five times, five... I lost count.
finisher_description: A spinning back-to-the-mat taunt, then an axe kick.

entrance_fx.music: Can You Dig It, Sucka (Five Times)

gimmick: A fitness legend who made the women's division matter and comes back for one more every couple of years.
finisher_description: A headscissors into a bulldog.

gimmick: A punk-rock flyer who changed women's wrestling, then the music business, then came back.
finisher_description: A moonsault.

gimmick: A smirking talker who left the upstart and is waiting by his phone for a better offer.
finisher_description: A spear.

gimmick: A tattooed Australian brawler who left his gang and his company in the same week.
finisher_description: A sit-out piledriver.

gimmick: A tattooed Dutch kicker who quotes dead poets and kicks living people.
finisher_description: A spinning back kick.

gimmick: A Canadian technician who ran the upstart's top title and now waits for the right offer.
finisher_description: An ankle lock.

gimmick: The best woman on the indies, who has turned down three offers and is holding out for a fourth.
finisher_description: A springboard cutter.

gimmick: A huge, friendly big man from the indies who brings his own sandwich to every match.
finisher_description: A body slam.

gimmick: A young New Zealander on her first world tour, who will sign with whoever buys her a plane ticket home.
finisher_description: A crossface.
